requirements.text: Ensure compliance with regulations like PSD2 and GDPR while prioritizing customer safety.
Evaluate specific features like real-time transaction notifications and card management for compliance.
Implement a thorough review process involving legal and compliance teams for each proposed feature.
Understand the limitations of the legacy core banking system and existing APIs to avoid compliance issues.
Focus on maintaining customer trust and security while adapting to potential regulatory changes.
Features involving customer authentication must meet the stringent requirements outlined in PSD2.
Customer data must be handled in compliance with GDPR, ensuring it is stored and processed properly.
New features should integrate through existing APIs without requiring significant modifications.
Conduct regular assessments of compliance implications for new features.
Features should enhance transparency for customers, such as real-time notifications of transactions.
Enable customers to manage their cards directly through the app.
